title: Home guide: the drying test
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: States of matter (Marvellous Medicine and How Far Can Sound Travel?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 11 (Home practical guide and safety card: drying test (portal worksheet))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out whether spreading out a wet cloth makes it dry faster.
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Wet both cloths with the same amount of water.
Spread one out flat. Fold the other.
Put them side by side in the same place.
Feel them every 30 minutes. Record which is drier.
